basic_details.job_title: Salem District Members Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Salem District Collectorate is inviting applications from eligible persons of the tribal community for five Members of the district-level Tribal Welfare Committee, two of whom will be women. Applications with a bio data must be submitted in person at the Project Office, Tribal Welfare, Room No. 305, Salem District Collectorate, by 16 November 2026.

qualification.details: Who can apply: persons belonging to the tribal community who are eligible. Work background: continuously working for the advancement of tribal people. Criminal cases: no criminal case should be pending against the applicant. Women: two of the five members will be women. | The notice states no educational qualification, so candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Salem District Collectorate Members at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the pay, the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Person of the tribal community, continuously working for tribal advancement, with no criminal case pending

content_sections.heading: About the Salem Tribal Welfare Committee
content_sections.text: The notice says a district-level "Tribal Welfare Committee" is to be formed in Salem district, which it describes as one of the areas where many tribal people live. The committee is meant to resolve the demands and needs of tribal people quickly. It is also meant to let their voice reach government policy and planning directly, and to help design welfare schemes to suit their needs.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice asks eligible persons to submit their willingness petition, along with a personal bio data, in person at the Project Office, Tribal Welfare, Room No. 305, Salem District Collectorate, on or before 16 November 2026. The notice does not mention submission by post or email, a prescribed form, or what to write on an envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Who can apply: persons belonging to the tribal community who are eligible. Work background: continuously working for the advancement of tribal people. Criminal cases: no criminal case should be pending against the applicant. Women: two of the five members will be women. The notice states no educational qualification, so candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Personal bio data (Bio data). The willingness petition (virupa manu) of the applicant.

faq.question: Q1. How many Members will be selected for the Salem Tribal Welfare Committee?
faq.answer: Five Members will be selected, and two of the five will be women.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 November 2026, and the application must be submitted in person by then.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Eligible persons of the tribal community who have been continuously working for tribal advancement and have no criminal case pending can apply.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit your willingness petition with your bio data in person at the Project Office, Tribal Welfare, Room No. 305, Salem District Collectorate.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply by post or email?
faq.answer: The notice asks only for submission in person at Room No. 305 and does not mention post or email.

faq.question: Q6. Is a woman candidate eligible?
faq.answer: Yes. Two of the five members will be women.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number of this notice?
faq.answer: The press release number is 762/2026, dated 11.11.2026.
